      properties:

          title: Title

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500

          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:

          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'

          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"

        - id

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized into E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped,
            an explicit leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country
            code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the
            national digits. The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 40
          example: '6085551023'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The e-mail address of the pet owner. Optional, but when present it
            must be a syntactically valid address. The value is stored and
            returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's
            current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and address (they knowingly share a
            household). Write-only; it is never stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                A stable customer code assigned when the owner is created,
                formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>': the upper-cased first three
                letters of city, a hyphen, the upper-cased first three letters
                of lastName, a hyphen, and a 4-digit zero-padded per-city
                sequence equal to one more than the number of owners already in
                that city at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted
                '<customerCode>-M<YY>': the customer code, the literal '-M', and
                the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who knowingly share a
                household (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner
                is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and another owner already
                lives at that address; every owner in the household is given the
                same value. Absent for owners that do not share a household.
              type: string
              example: 'e3b0c442-98fc-3c14-9afb-4c8996fb9242'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned when the owner is
                created and never changes afterwards.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: >-
                The owner's membership tier. 'SILVER' when the owner has no
                namesakes (namesakeCount is 0) and an email address is present;
                otherwise 'BRONZE'.
              type: string
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements

          format: int64

        totalPages:

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0

        - content

        - totalElements

    PetPage:

      properties:

          description: Pets in the requested page.

          items:

        page:

          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1

        totalElements:
          title: Total elements

          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2

        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetFields:
      title: Pet fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet.
          type: string
          maxLength: 30
